title: Add a Hebrew/RTL locale variant to invite_tutor_screen_l1_test.dart and manage_grants_screen_l1_test.dart

evidence.quote: locale: const Locale('en'), // _buildApp has no locale parameter
locale: Locale('en'), // buildSubject has no locale parameter
'leading FilterChip is fully on-screen in RTL (Hebrew) — not clipped at edge'

why: Two sibling l1 tests in this exact batch (manage_tutors_screen_l1_test.dart, tutor_audit_log_screen_l1_test.dart) each carry a Locale('he') case — and the audit-log one exists specifically because an earlier RTL clipping bug was found (comment: 'not clipped at edge'), proving this class of bug is real for this feature. invite_tutor_screen_l1_test.dart and manage_grants_screen_l1_test.dart hardcode Locale('en') with no way to parameterize it, so a directional-layout regression on either screen would ship with green tests.
recommendation: Parameterize _buildApp/buildSubject with a Locale argument and add one Locale('he') testWidgets case per screen asserting key rows/buttons render without overflow, matching tutor_audit_log_screen_l1_test.dart's pattern.
acceptance_criteria: invite_tutor_screen_l1_test.dart has a Locale('he') case asserting the form/Send button render without RenderFlex overflow
manage_grants_screen_l1_test.dart has the same for the active/pending grant rows
